_memoryBaseline.status: NOT MEASURED YET - memoryLimitMb stays 0 until it is
_memoryBaseline.soak: fill in: date, hours, machine, panel lineup
_memoryBaseline.rule: memoryLimitMb = roundUp250(max(1.35*p95_24h, 1.15*peak_72h)); memoryHardLimitMb = roundUp250(max(2*p95_24h, memoryLimitMb+750)). See memoryLimitFromBaseline() in src/upkeep.js.
_memoryBaseline.why: A limit inside the normal operating band is worse than no limit: it rebuilds a panel on every check. Measured with a limit under the baseline, memory went from 1513MB to 1885MB while recycling every five seconds. See docs/validation.md.
_memoryBaseline.measured_so_far: four live public dashboards on the dev machine, macOS: 1513MB total (Tab 1143, Browser 169, GPU 131, Utility 70). Not the show PC, not the real dashboards, one instantaneous sample.
